about: Every setting the settings window shows (the gear button in the Unity chat window and in the Blender panel, and `claude_hand.py settings`), and every feature of the lab. This file is the one list: tools/handlib/prefs.py, Claude Hand Tools in Unity (ChSettings.cs) and the Blender add-on all read it, and draw a row for each entry. The values themselves are in ~/.claude-hand/config.json: a setting under its key, a lab feature under "lab". kind: switch (true/false), choice (one of choices), days (a whole number, 0 for never). applies: now (every part reads config.json again when it changes) or start (from the next start of Claude Hand). A lab feature is off until the user turns it on; once it has proved itself, change its stage from "lab" to "stable": it is then on for everybody, whatever config.json says, and leaves the lab tab. What guards the windows (the guard hook, protection rules, undo points) is not a setting and never goes into the lab.

hint.ko: 화면에 보이는 글의 언어입니다. 요청은 어느 언어로 써도 됩니다.
hint.en: The language of the interface. You can write your requests in any language.

name.en: Time and token line for each request

hint.ko: 결과 답 아래에 그 요청에 든 시간 · 동작 · 토큰을 한 줄로 보여 줍니다. 꺼도 기록과 usage 명령에는 남습니다.
hint.en: Shows under each result what the request took in time, actions and tokens. Turned off, it is still recorded and shown by the usage command.

name.en: Pictures of the other windows a request changed

hint.ko: 요청이 다른 창을 바꿨으면 결과 아래에 그 창의 지금 모습을 그림으로 붙입니다.
hint.en: When a request changed another window, a picture of how that window looks now is attached under the result.

name.en: Blink the taskbar button when an answer comes

hint.ko: 다른 프로그램을 보는 동안 답이나 허락 요청이 오면 작업 표시줄 단추를 깜빡입니다(Windows).
hint.en: Blinks the taskbar button when an answer or a permission request comes while you are in another program (Windows).

name.en: Show in the Claude desktop app (Remote Control)

hint.ko: Claude 데스크톱 앱의 Code 탭, claude.ai/code, 모바일 앱에 'Claude Hand' 세션이 보입니다.
hint.en: The 'Claude Hand' session shows in the Code tab of the Claude desktop app, on claude.ai/code and in the mobile app.

name.en: Minimize the Claude Hand window by itself

hint.ko: 세션이 일을 시작하면 검은 Claude Hand 창을 최소화합니다(Windows).
hint.en: Minimizes the black Claude Hand window once the session starts working (Windows).

name.en: Days to keep the chat history

hint.ko: 채팅창에 다시 보여 주는 지난 대화와 그 그림을 이 날수만큼 둡니다. 0이면 날짜로는 지우지 않습니다(창마다 최근 100개).
hint.en: How long the earlier conversation shown again in the chat panels, and its pictures, are kept. 0: never removed by date (the newest 100 items of each window).

hint.ko: 창 사이에 옮기며 교환 폴더에 남은 파일 사본을 이 날수만큼 둡니다. 0이면 지우지 않습니다.
hint.en: How long the copies left in the exchange folder by moving things between windows are kept. 0: never removed.

hint.ko: 언어가 English일 때 Claude에게 주는 지침(하위 세션, 감독 규칙)도 영어판으로 줍니다. 꺼 두면 지침은 한국어 그대로이고 영어 버튼 이름 대조표만 붙습니다. 아직 실제 작업으로 다듬지 않은 글입니다.
hint.en: With the language set to English, Claude's own instructions (subagents, supervisor rules) are given in their English edition too. Turned off, the instructions stay Korean and only a table of the English button names is added. These texts have not been refined in real work yet.
